task_type_fields.evidence: Proposed by sase-1jy.4 (note #2, epic sase-1jy). Check ToolRun 681db15274b695a8d9477d2b51e843cb (2026-10-11, loaded host) failed: the nested run printed 'lint (mypy) failed/1 ... verdict: undetermined — 1 KNOWN; exit 1' where the test asserts 'verdict: no_new_failures' (triaged NEW). evidence.note: Independent recurrence proposed by phase sase-1mk.9.5 (note #1, epic sase-1mk.9) on 2026-10-18 and triaged by the sase-1mk.9 land agent. A 20-iteration -n 8 stress loop over tests/tool/test_known_continuation.py plus tests/fakey/test_provider_drain_e2e.py failed once, in iteration 16: tests/tool/test_known_continuation.py::test_agent_run_continues_past_all_known_stage stopped with helper_error and yielded 'undetermined — 1 KNOWN'. The other 19 iterations were clean (30 passed each). After the scoped check rebuilt the linked sase-core-rs 0.42.0 extension, the node passed in the scoped check and in a standalone -n 8 rerun. Phase commit e5c02dc8a4 added a 2s ToolRun store busy_timeout to the triage helper, so a recurrence after that commit means a different helper failure than SQLite writer-lock contention.
